seoTitle: Third-Party Domain Classifier: Vendor and Category
metaDescription: Paste domains or URLs and see the vendor and category for each: analytics, advertising, social, fonts, CDN. Free offline list.
intro: Matches domains against a built-in list of about 150 well-known vendors and groups them by category.
why:
A privacy review often starts with a list of domains from a network log, a sitemap of embeds or a scanner export. The next step is working out who each domain belongs to and what it does.

This tool matches each name (including subdomains) against a built-in list of common analytics, advertising, social, session replay, fonts, chat and CDN domains. Anything else is listed as unclassified for you to research. The list is not a full tracker database and it cannot tell what a request actually sends.
howTo: Paste domains or full URLs, one per line.
Read the groups and the unclassified list.
Research the unclassified domains and add vendors to your policy.

faq.a: About 150 well-known domains. It is a starting point, not a database.

faq.q: Can it see what data is sent?

faq.a: They show as unclassified. Remove your own domains before pasting.
